name: CGS International Inc.
summary: Founded in 1978 and headquartered in Taipei City, Taiwan, CGS International Inc. primarily specializes in supplying computer peripheral equipment across the Taiwanese market. Beyond its core hardware provisions, the company offers extensive system integration services and essential repair and maintenance support. Its operations further encompass a broad range of software solutions, from strategic planning and development to implementation and expert consulting. Additionally, CGS International Inc. is involved in the creation and commercialization of mobile and platform-based video games.
